title: [IMP-5] `channelCID` is used as exporter context but never defined; DMs have none
description: Review finding IMP-5: `channelCID` is used as exporter context but never defined; DMs have none (lens IMP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:194, :202, :218; spec/03-spaces.md:166; spec/04-access-control.md:125, :145. Fix: Grep finds no definition of `channelCID` anywhere. Channels are entries in SpaceState (03:60-98), not content-addressed objects. The only DM CID changes on every membership change (04:145), which would change access and sealing keys mid-epoch. Also used as an identifier in BroadcastKey (03:173), BroadcastMessage (05:148), SpeakRequest (05:98), RecordingGrant (06:250) and `homeChannelCID` (08:81). Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
